summary.headline: Astrological Catalogue Entries 166–181
summary.text: Astrological catalogue entries 166–181 cover locating things and their recovery, human-shaped signs, decans and the twelve signs’ faces, lunar and solar eclipses, universal lunar configurations, blemishes, travelers, delays, prisoners, runaways according to Protagoras of Nicaea, a woman’s return to her husband, and glory, honor, and dignities.
